subject: FY2025 Property Tax Rate Allocation
overview: The City Council held a public hearing to determine the fiscal year 2025 property tax allocation. The Council approved the maximum tax shift onto commercial properties while voting against open space, residential, and small commercial exemptions.

items.title: FY2025 Property Tax Allocation Hearing
items.summary: The Council approved the maximum allowable 175% tax shift onto commercial properties and voted against adopting open space, residential, and small commercial exemptions for FY2025. Additionally, the Council approved a motion requesting legal guidance and property data regarding potential future adoption of a residential tax exemption.
